RunTransition.title: RunTransition
RunTransition.description: One typed run-state transition: cause, acting principal (provenance), and the caller-supplied instant; the genesis record carries from: null.

SimulationRunStatus.title: SimulationRunStatus
SimulationRunStatus.description: One run lifecycle status: submitted, scheduled, running, or the terminal completed / failed / cancelled.

RunTransitionCause.title: RunTransitionCause
RunTransitionCause.description: The typed cause of a run-state transition: submission, planning, dispatch, result-ingested, execution-failed, result-rejected, or cancellation.

FabricPrincipalId.title: FabricPrincipalId
FabricPrincipalId.description: Acting principal of a fabric operation: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (the W009/W010 actor grammar, mirrored).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
